reference_census.method: Every base §x.y / II.x, volume reference (V0n §x, Vn §x, Vn-x.y), J-/T-/BCR- id, D- id, file f and g item and file path in both volumes was extracted by script (work/vol-V05-V06/refs.py) and resolved against ARCHITECTURE.md headings, the volumes' numbered headings and bold sub-numbers, the defining J/T/BCR tables, AMENDMENTS-2026-09-28f.md and -28g.md item numbers, and the file system. Script-unresolved hits were checked by hand: base-kind hits are list continuations of another volume's sections ('volume 1 (V01) §2.4, §3.10.3'), resolved against the named volume; ownbare hits are the volume's own sections cited bare (resolve; V06 §2.2's table form collides with base kernel numbers, V06-TERM-1); style hits are single-digit volume prefixes (V05-TERM-1, V06-TERM-1); file hits are session scratch paths (BREF). What remains broken is itemized under broken_references.

items.statement: Plain-words summary: islands only at CITY and METROPOLIS with the fantasy setting on (off by default); a wealth-weighted roll gives 0-3 islands; richer town = likelier, higher, bigger; richer carried households = bigger.

Plain words: an island carries either one to three rich neighbourhoods moved up from the town (population kept whole) or one unique institution (palace, cathedral, prison); laid out by the neighbourhood machinery with no road in or out; richest on high ground and rim, less wealthy lower and inner.

Plain words: an institution sent up hands its ground site over (largest church takes the cathedral close; old palace site becomes town hall or palace gardens); the island cathedral's crypt is cut in the island rock and is still the largest; islands never have catacombs.

Plain words: shapes round, D, lozenge, crescent, spindle; rocky rim; gentle echo hills; often a conjured river spilling off as a waterfall to mist; floats over water, fields or outskirts, over the heart only on request; drawn translucent (solid or lifted switchable); shadow follows the sun under the pointer; rim lights and underglow at night.

Plain words: access by hoists (winch house, cage, landing yard) or over water an inclined rope line to a shore tower; with magic a floating stair or bridge of light; every island has at least one way up; every ground landing is a small yard on a street.

Plain words: island shade computed over a typical day using the real bulk (rim + tapering root); shaded ground a little poorer; never more than one wealth step from shade alone; moved islands' shade catches up at the next period; shade map; clerk why; shade basis remembered so save/reopen never changes picture; 'Update shade now' button.

Plain words: island shops follow ground siting rules with the hoist ride as the trip; each island neighbourhood counts as a district for coverage; smelly/dirty trades, heavy works and warehouses never go up; split works/shop allowed; supply chains keep working steps on the ground.
Plain words: an island needs no wall (cliffs are its wall); an author's island wall walls only hoist tops each with a gate; clerk says 'the drop is the wall'.

Plain words: viaducts, raised roads and aqueducts pass beneath and never reach an island; landing yards keep clear of arches; rope line well above decks; a road drawn to the edge becomes a hoist offer; island terraces allowed but never along the edge; on a fall, arches, piers and terrace walls break and shops on a covered bridge fall.
Plain words: a dossier magical node lowers upkeep so islands are a little likelier, bigger and higher.

Plain words: decline shrinks and lowers islands; unpaid magic empties an island to lowest height; years unchanged then it falls, leaving a quarried rubble field and breaking what it lands on; returning wealth re-raises an abandoned island before any new one; dossier-removed institution refloats as another institution or rich neighbourhood or sinks.

Plain words: every island edit undoable; changing an island never disturbs the city below except its hoists' landing yards; a removed island or hoist stays removed (clerk 'removed by you') unless undone or drawn by hand when all other places are taken; more islands open new places only; if none appears the map says why and offers two remedies.

Pointer convention: 'V5 §n' names this volume; bare §n (and II.n, D-n, J-…) names the base; another volume 'V0n §n'; a list after a volume prefix stays in that volume; the base requests write this volume as 'V05 §n'.

Two kinds of tier (J-V5.66): underside tiers = the rock beneath an island (tier 0 rim slab, tiers 1..n root, V5 §3.9 (2)); massing tiers = a stepped building's stacked wings (item 110 (c), V02 §3.15); a bare 'tier' in V5 §3.9 (2) and §3.19 (2)-(5) is an underside tier.
Raised-way piers = item 110 (b)'s supports on ground part 0; a bare 'pier' is a harbour pier (§4.8), as in volume 4.

V05 builds 23 subjects to build depth: existence/count, supply law, purpose, sky allocation, shape, placement, island arena, altitude/underside, access, island field + handover, lights/names, over time, ladders/determinism, shade strip, siting rulebook across island, custom chains across island, magical node, model sun sample set, shade basis, ground reservation handover + crypt, rim barrier, supply web across island, item 110 on/under/against the island.
V05 fixes the model sun's sample set where item 102 leaves it open: nine suns at the equinox and one sample point per field cell by default, on V06's building shade mask layout.
RungProfile.layers.islands is 'none' at TOWN and the village rungs, 'possible' at CITY and METROPOLIS (stated in the hook table's 'gives' column).

V01 BCR-39 (critique V1C-69, alias I110R-1): recommended slot of item 110 (b)'s generation: viaducts inside S4, elevated roads and aqueducts at S6's end, before S7b (1); so raised parts exist when SKY runs.

Out of scope: laying the island's districts, blocks, plots and buildings is V01's unit run (V01 §3.10); V05 hands it the arena, land face, rim strip, claims, landings, district count and seeds, allocation, field values (V5 §2.3) and reads back.
Out of scope: scheduling epochs is V06; V05 states the island laws an epoch applies (IslandEpochStep) and conversions they emit.

Out of scope: screens/panels/gestures V09; clerk prompts V10; word lists and grammar rows for island names V11; calibration runs V12 (each calibrate-later constant names default, measurement, fallback).

Islands have no relation to the underground: nothing in V05 reads or writes an underground part; a churchyard on a sky plot is a surface burial ground only, never a catacomb candidate and never ranked largest cemetery; each island church still counts once toward the catacomb count (V04 §3.5.1 (3), CatacombRule.count churchesPer); an island cathedral's crypt (always the settlement's largest) is a vault in the rim slab, part of its building, never an UndergroundSystem part or item 109 (j) (3b) link (J-V5.43); landfall rubble sources no underground quarry.

Out of scope: the daylight term itself (w_sun, sun samples, pass-1 terrain and wall shade, the sunlit-side preference, §13 bars) is the base's by item 102; drift over epochs is V06's (item 102 (e)); the shade map view and siting explanations on screen V09's; clerk prompts V10's; class siting profiles, supply edges, coverage rows, signature pairs V11's.

Out of scope: custom chains' discovery/activation/arrival V08's; a chain's street-scale closeness and any quarter past item 72's threshold V01's (item 107 (e) revising item 104 (h) (3)); chain placement rules V11's; magical_node position (ruin centre, else S12a decoration site) V08's and V04's; crypt room plan V03's, basement form V02's; item 110's own work the base's, V02's, V01's, V04's, V06's.

SkyIsland (replaces §2.7's SkyIsland, BCR-V5-1): id 'sky<part>/island:<token>'; slot 1/2/3; key {layer:'sky', part} from Document.nextSkyPart never reused; anchor PointCm (island point p stands over ground at anchor+p); rim ChainRef ('rim', island id); land FaceRef; areaHa (land face within ±1 % of it); altitudeCm above groundRefCm; groundRefCm; underside UndersideProfile; terrain? (datumCm = ground datum + elevationCm); terrainEcho?; river?; districts; allocation; reason prosperity/institution; institution?; placement {over water/fields/outskirts/core, byAssignment}; occlusion? opaque/ghost/offset; supply {town, carried}; field {prosperity, density, greenery}; shadeBasis?; accesses (ordinal order); name?; state floating/waning/settled/fallen/removed; stateSince {epoch, week}; dwellUntilWeek?; removed? {seq, generated, releasedBy?}; removedAccesses number[] ([] default); landfall?; declared? {outline, position, altitude, area, field}; lifecycle. All lengths integer cm; values on [0,1].
SkyIsland.slot: a fallen island frees its slot; a removed one holds it closed until removed.releasedBy is set (V5 §3.2 (6)).

groundRefCm = greatest, under the projected solid, of the ground terrain height plus the caster ceiling there; fixed at SKY before plots are cut so field pass 2 can read the shade; raised only by SKY-F's clearance check, the epoch's reclearIsland (V5 §3.15 (7)) or a ground edit beneath (V5 §3.9 (5), §4.3); casters include item 110's raised parts, retaining walls, massing tiers, levelled platforms.
elevationCm is derived at read: groundRefCm + altitudeCm — the island terrain's surface datum and the z base of every sky mark (§8.1, §8.4); never stored.

shadeBasis is written only by a shade evaluation, never by an island edit; absent on an island raised or declared since the last evaluation (epoch raiseIsland after S6, a T5 declaration, a hand convert raiseIsland), which casts and receives no strip until the next evaluation writes it (J-V5.72).

SkyIsland.removed.releasedBy: the seq of the T5 sky declaration that re-filled its slot when no slot was free (the user's re-add serving that key, file f item 260); never an adjust('islands.count'); absent = slot held closed.

UndersideProfile {kind cone/bowl/root/flat (radius ratio ρ(z) at depth fraction z: cone 1−z, bowl √(1−z²), root (1−z)², flat no root); rimThicknessCm (rim base this far below elevationCm); depthCm (0 for flat); apexOffset VecCm local ((0,0) for flat); tiers (root slab tiers below tier 0; 0 for flat); roughness 0-1; source rule/edit ('edit' once any setAttr: held by resizes, which scale depthCm only by the area's square-root ratio)}.

ShadeBasis {epoch; by generation/rederive/epoch; anchor; elevationCm; groundRefCm; surfaceTopCm (tier 0 top: terrain surface at generation/rederive, full surface top at an epoch); underside copy; rim PointCm[] local, chain order from lowest-(y,x) vertex, ≤ shade.basisVertexCap (256), longer reduced by kernel simplification at 1 m tolerance (§3.4), moving no strip bit at 32 m cell (T-V5-20)} — a copy, never a vertex (§2.2 rule 5; C5-01; BCR-V5-21).

Local coordinates, one world anchor: an island arena is laid in a local frame centred on (0,0); the island stands over the ground by one integer translation anchor; a move is one attribute; nothing re-snapped/re-keyed/re-derived by it; every ground-meeting reader converts by the translation alone (S14, slab list, exports, placement, landing points); every logged island position is local; no rotation (integer translation keeps lattice points, §3.2 (7)); a turned island is a reshape (warp on its key).

removedSlots(doc) (@plat/sky, draw-free): {island, slot, name?, seq, accesses number[]}[] — every removed island whose slot is still held and every island's removedAccesses, in slot order; read by V09's info.remove.holds card and history row and the clerk (V5 §4.5); derived, never stored.

Document.nextSkyPart: number — the part the next island takes (1 at creation), never decreasing (like nextUndergroundPart); the creating event records the part in the island's address so replay reads it; slot (1-3) is the count law's, part is identity; a fallen island's part stays spent (BCR-V5-2).

SkyAccess {id 'sky<part>/skyaccess:<token>' keyed in its island arena; island; kind hoist/ropeway/stair/lightBridge; top VertexRef ('sky_access', access id) on the rim chain; topLanding (island-side landing Reservation); ground {at PointCm world foot (point attribute carried under a warp, §7.4), plot?}; role main/service/guarded; state open/closed (stored: hand closure only; unserved and ruined derived); knownTo public/local/secret; rule (the SkyAccessRow); lifecycle} (BCR-V5-1).

No access is a way (J-V5.61): a SkyAccess is never a way, an arena edge between arenas or a portal; carries no deck plots; a raised way never reaches an island; its foot stands on ground part-0 land only, never on a deck face, a raised-way pier or under a raised deck (V5 §3.10 (4); J-V5.60).

Derived at read, never stored: access run (hoist, stair: vertical drop from rim base to foot's ground; ropeway, lightBridge: 3-D length top to foot), slope, foot's ground height; maxRunM limits the horizontal distance from top's world point to foot for both slanted kinds; unserved (island waning past half its dwell, or settled) and ruined (fallen) derived.

Stair path: helix of radius access.stair.radiusM (6 m) about the vertical through the foot, from foot's ground to rim base, rising access.stair.stepM (0.5 m) per step, landing every access.stair.landingM (20 m) of rise, last turn ending at the top; marks and glTF steps laid along it.

A secret access's ground landing carries its knownTo: its sky_landing use is fronted by item 63's front mode (a warehouse or stable, the sky_landing row's front column) and withheld from every key that does not admit it (§9.2's filter).

SkyHandover (derived view, draw-free, never persisted): {island, key, land FaceRef L0, rimStrip FaceRef L1 (never cut, never plotted), claims (institution Reservation + every landing Reservation — holes), landings {reservation, attach VertexRef ('attach', reservation, 0), access, role}[], river?, allocation, field {raster {cellCm 3200, origin local, w, h, values Float32Array (prosperity before brush strokes)}, mean, density, greenery} (never recomputed from h(S_carried)), context {reason, institutionKind?, districtKind ('sky-island' or the institution row's districtKind on the claim's face), districtHa, fabricHint (a PRIOR: hinted template weight × fabricPrior), fabricPrior (3)}}; one caller: V01's unit runner when the request's layer is 'sky'.

SKY builds per island the NeighbourhoodRequest of V01 §2.4: district = the island's sky pseudo-district, key its arena, layer 'sky', boundary = land face runs (every rim run a hard sky seam, no portal), laid empty (mode unit), strategy absent (S7c picks per island district, fabricHint as prior); calls NeighbourhoodStrategy.generate; the unit runner reads skyHandover for the rest; re-assembled at every unit run (generation, raiseIsland, New random; V01 V1-3.10.3 (6)).

The partition is V01's: island district count and cut are V01 §3.10.3 (2)'s (V05 neither counts nor seeds, J-V5.28); k = V01's skyDistrictCount(plotLandM2, districtHa) (V01 V1-3.16) with context.districtHa; share = V01's hood.constants.sky.plotShare (V01 V1-3.14), never a copy here (J-V5.45).

IslandShadeStrip = islandShadeStrip(doc, island, samples, onto) (pure, draw-free): {island (caster), onto 'ground' or a lower island's Id, basis Hash64 (§6.2 hash of caster's shadeBasis, and onto an island the receiver's, the sampler's digest, the receiver terrain's version under the window = hash of UNLEVELLED heights, J-V5.65), evaluated {epoch, by}, window {i0, j0, w, h} in 32 m receiver cells, bits (sample points × sun positions, 1 × 9 default, BCR-V5-15), mask Uint8Array w×h cells row-major ⌈bits/8⌉ bytes each (bit point·suns+sun set where the ray meets the island solid; V06 §2.6's layout), cells (count with any bit)}.

Where strips live: strips onto the ground held with the prosperity field's rasters (§4.5) beside the daylight per-sample mask they are OR-ed into, hashed as those rasters (§6.2), no digest rule of their own; strips onto an island held with that island's field values; nothing edits one (J-V5.30); readers are only the field's composition, sky receivers' context values, V01's S9b manor sun factor, hood pins' shade gate, DistrictContext.shade.islandShare (and on an island via shadeSky, S7c's shade term via DistrictContext.shade.meanShare), the clerk, the shade map view.

A strip is a pure function of its caster's shadeBasis, the receiver (ground's committed terrain S1 + T2 strokes unlevelled, or the receiving island's shadeBasis and terrain) and the sampler, never the live island; so load, replay and recomputation rebuild the same bits (§2.9, BCR-V5-21); only the shade view's pending outline and the clerk's 'has the ground caught up' read the live island (V5 §3.19 (8)); strips computed at every evaluation whatever w_sun is (0 included).

skyAccessObstacles(doc): SkyAccessObstacle[] (pure, draw-free, from committed accesses; world cm above ground datum): column {access, at (foot; hoist: its yard centre), radiusCm (hoist: yard half-diagonal; stair: access.stair.radiusM + 1 m), floorCm, topCm (rim base = elevationCm − rimThicknessCm)} or segment {access, a (top world point at rim base), b (foot at ground), clearCm = accessSiting.lineClearM (8 m)}; one entry per open or unserved access of every non-fallen non-removed island; hoist/stair a column, ropeway/lightBridge a segment; rebuilt every call (≤ 9 entries), never stored (C5-48, BCR-V5-29).
Against access obstacles: a deck, its parapet and its raised-way piers stay outside every column; a deck crossing under a segment keeps clearCm below it.

IslandRule (revised, BCR-V5-4; islands.json in @plat/tables; one row per rung CITY/METROPOLIS): chance [3]; townSupply {v,h}[]; carriedSupply {v,h}[]; areaHaMax; minAreaHa; altitudeM [E_min,E_max]; clearanceM; casterAllowanceM; surfaceTopPercentile; shade {ringMaskM, stepM, basisVertexCap}; routing {transferM}; underside {kinds[{kind,weight}], rimThicknessM, depthPerRadius, maxDepthM, apexOffsetShare, tiers, roughness}; placement {prefs[{over,weight}], gapM, frameInsetM, nearM, latticeM, topK}; outline {templates[{template,weight}], detail}; frameMarginM; terrain none/echo/own; echo {amplitudeShare, domeM, domePerRadius, tiltPerMille}; river {chance, minAreaHa, flowShare, widthM, widthMinorShare, springPondChance, sourceShare, pondShare}; institutions; access; accessCount {perHa, max}; accessSiting {footGapM, turnStepCdeg, turnMaxCdeg, deckGapM, lineClearM}; stair {radiusM, stepM, landingM}; landing {yardWidthM, yardDepthM, rimStripM, wayReachM}; fill {batchShare, householdCapDistricts, coverageOvershoot}; institutionFit {fitFactor, areaCapShare, prisonMarginM, siteLatticeM}; cryptFloorM; districtHa; fabricPrior; fabricRingHa; field {epsilonShare, epsilonWavelengthM, greeneryBonus, rank{elevation,view}, bandInset}; carry CarryRule; node {bonus}; hysteresis; dwellYears {waning, settled}; growthPerYear; altitudeRateMPerYear; redrawPerYear; landfall {coverShare, stoneM3PerM2}; landingKernel {weight, radiusM}; naming {lowBelowM, highFromM}; export {gltfRingPoints, mistM}. Every cell {value, unit, provenance, calibratable}, editable by editTable (§7.6).
IslandRule.chance = [0.6, 0.5, 0.35] (II.6 (4)) and redrawPerYear = 0.1 (II.6 (4)) stated with values in the volume's record comments.

CarryRule (item 23: a default, never a law; every list editable): never {balance (item 107 (a) profiles), emitsTopStep smell/smoke/waterPollution (item 103 (a) EMITS at top step), chainRoles resource/processing of an active chain (custom or activeChains[]) — the island's own institution excepted, hardNeeds}; share {balance, splitShop (item 105 (h) split class's shop may go up by share, works on ground)}.

IslandInstitution {kind; tags (roster class tags in preference order); requirementBand; areaHa; staffHouseholds; weight; requires {government?, magic? low/high}; districtKind (sky-*); fabricHint; archetypes? [{id (SettlementForge scene archetype, item 104 (a) (2)), landmarkOnly}]; handover {tags, else park/none}; accesses main/service/guarded[]; near? plaza/precinct/richest; far? plaza; nearM; overWeights?}.
SkyAccessRow {kind; magic none/low/high[]; weight; maxAltitudeM?; maxRunM? (horizontal top-to-foot); needsLandBelow; extension: true}.

Default rows are own values (provenance own, extension: no reference has islands, II.6 (8)), each calibratable; three marked ⟨P0⟩ (townSupply, carriedSupply, casterAllowanceM) are set by M6-sky's P0 run before the table lands with V5 §3.3 / §3.9 (5)'s measurement and fallback; every calibratable cell takes its register entry from V12 §3.11's default line written by the seat landing P1 (J-V5.80).
townSupply ⟨P0⟩ (CITY=METROPOLIS): (0.45,0) (0.58,0.5) (0.70,1) on absolute field values; carriedSupply ⟨P0⟩: (0.55,0) (0.85,1) (a rich-band household in a modest town reads ≈ 0.75).
areaHaMax/minAreaHa: CITY 10/1.5 ha, METROPOLIS 20/1.5 ha; altitudeM/clearanceM: CITY [60,160]/25 m, METROPOLIS [80,220]/25 m.
underside defaults: kinds cone 0.30, bowl 0.25, root 0.40, flat 0.05; rim 10 m; depth 0.45 × equivalent radius ≤ 110 m; apex offset ≤ 0.25 × radius; 6 tiers; roughness 0.15 (J98).
placement: prefs water 1.0, fields 0.8, outskirts 0.6, core 0 (II.6's default placement); gap 80 m, frame inset 50 m, near 600 m, lattice 40 m, top 5.
outline.templates: disc 0.25, d_shape 0.15, lozenge 0.20, crescent 0.10, spindle 0.30; detail rough (§4.2 S1 (2) rows); frameMarginM 40 m.

terrain echo default; amplitude 0.25 of the ground's relief class, dome 6 m + 0.02 × radius, tilt 8 ‰; river chance 0.75, ≥ 3 ha, flow share 0.02, width [3 m, 0.08 × minor axis], spring pond 0.5; source at 0.15 of long axis from upstream end; spring pond area 0.015 of A.
landing: yard 12 × 14 m, rim strip 6 m, way reach 60 m; landingKernel weight 0.05, radius 150 m (field pass 2).
field: ε share 0.05, greenery bonus +0.10; ε wavelength 120 m; rank 0.6 × elevation + 0.4 × view; band inset 0.1 of each band's width (J-V5.18).

dynamics: hysteresis 0.05, dwell waning [5,15] y, settled [10,40] y, growth 0.05 of area per year, altitude 4 m per year, redraw 0.1 per year (per year, §4.11 (5)); landfall cover share 0.5, stone 3 m³ per m².

surfaceTopPercentile 95; accessCount one per 5 ha at most 3; accessSiting feet ≥ 30 m apart, turns of 30° up to ±90°, deck gap 4 m, line clearance 8 m; stair helix 6 m, 0.5 m per step, landing every 20 m of rise.

fill: batch 1 % of band demand (≥ 1 household), cap 3 × H_d, coverage overshoot 1.05; institutionFit: fit 1.3 × row area, island cap 2.5 × row area, prison yard margin 20 m, claim site lattice 10 m; cryptFloorM 1 m.
districtHa CITY 3.5 ha, METROPOLIS 4.5 ha (about one Neighbourhood patch per island district; a full island is two or three districts; J-V5.45); fabricPrior 3; fabricRingHa 6 ha.

carry defaults: never balance heavy-processor, wholesale-storage; smell, smoke, water pollution at top step; chain resource and processing nodes; hard needs running_water, river_bank, harbour, gate, quay; by share balance everyday, specialist; split shops on.

shade.basisVertexCap 256; naming low below 90 m, high from 150 m; export glTF rings 64 points, mist quad 30 m; casterAllowanceM ⟨P0⟩ CITY 30 m, METROPOLIS 40 m; shade ring masks 4 m, ray step 8 m; routing transfer 100 m; node bonus 0.25.

Institution rows: palace (tags palace; rich; 3.0 ha; 40 staff; weight 0.35; government crown or seigneurial; sky-palace / street; main, service; near plaza 1000 m; martial-keep landmark only; handover town_hall, guildhall else park); cathedral (cathedral, great_temple; prosperous; 1.5 ha; 20; 0.25; —; sky-temple / landmark; main, service; near precinct where reserved else plaza, 800 m; sacred-sanctuary landmark only; church, temple, chapel else park); prison (prison; prosperous; 1.2 ha; 15; 0.20; —; sky-prison / square; guarded; far from plaza ≥ 1000 m, water 1.5; —; none); tower (mage_tower lowest-ordinal instance, mages_guild; prosperous; 0.6 ha; 4; 0.20; magic low or high; sky-tower / square; main; far from plaza ≥ 600 m, fields 1.2; exotic-tower any level; none).

Tower row: the owner's unique institution read for an arcane tower on its own ground (item 104 (a) (2)); takes a mage_tower instance (lowest roster ordinal not a member of a collective record, item 108) or the town's mages_guild, or a custom kind of that archetype, only where the world has magic (J-V5.31). Cathedral row's second tag is the great temple of a town whose religion row names one (V11 great_temple 'as cathedral'; J-V5.58).

A prison's band is its paymaster's (prosperous), not its inmates'. A handover tag is taken by the largest instance of that class the roster demands on the ground (greatest planned plot area at its band, §4.2 S2; ties by roster ordinal) — the cathedral close passes to the greatest parish church, the mother church (J-V5.43).

Access rows: hoist (magic none/low/high; weight 1.0; altitude ≤ 400 m; land below yes); ropeway (none/low/high; 0.8; horizontal run ≤ 350 m; no — chosen where ground below rim is water); stair (low/high; 0.3 at low, 0.4 at high; altitude ≤ 120 m; yes); lightBridge (high; 0.5; horizontal run ≤ 600 m; no).

Landing classes (facts here; rows V11's, §10.2 schema): sky_landing on the ground — yard plot 150-400 m² fronting a way (or by trail), one building by kind: two-storey hoist house under a gantry 6 × 8 m, rope-line tower 6 × 6 m 18 m, stair foot arch, light-bridge plinth; staffed by two modest households allocated to its host district or hinterland. sky_landing_top on the island — landing yard plot on the rim with winch house and crane arm 8 × 10 m, rope-line tower, stair terrace or bridge pylon; no households.

District kinds: sky-island for a prosperity island's districts; sky-palace, sky-temple, sky-prison, sky-tower from the institution rows on the claim's face (data rows of §10.2's district-kind table, BCR-V5-6; keyed apart from ground kinds); V01's unit runner types island faces with them; each row carries its ground counterpart's affinities for S7b's split and S7c (sky-island those of the richest ground kind), rows V11's.

Landing classes' siting facts (item 103 (a) profile columns): sky_landing sited by its access never by a pull (NEEDS satisfied by construction); EMITS heavy traffic at mid scale and noise at lowest non-zero step; CLIENTELE town-wide; SUPPLY none (it is the island's gate for the route distance); ALIGNMENT neutral except guarded takes its prison's law-and-enforcement alignment; COVERAGE none; sky_landing_top the same on the island.

Identity: SkyIsland lineage = the town; slot at generation; at an epoch town, slot and epoch component (J-A8.61); declared island its event seq; address sky<part>/island:…; anchor its slot. Terrain/river/L0/L1 pieces: the island's SKY run by §6.3 canonical order. SkyAccess: island; ordinal in siting order; hand-placed its event seq; address sky<part>/skyaccess:…; anchor (island address, role, ordinal). Island landing Reservation: island + access ordinal; sky<part>/reservation:…. Ground landing plot: ordinary ground plot. Landfall Decoration: the fallen island; ground; anchor its island's address. Unit-run entities are ordinary arena entities under §6.3 with lineage continuing the island's.

slot: create S7b (5) slot draw (a declaration takes the lowest free slot, or the lowest held slot when none free); read epoch redraw, raiseIsland, anchor match; persist model digest; regen kept by succession, a held slot never drawn/filled; undo from the undo record; migrate new.

key / nextSkyPart: create takes nextSkyPart and bumps; persist model digest and counter; regen successor keeps predecessor's key (§6.3); undo counter never decreases; migrate nextSkyPart = 1 + highest sky part present, 1 if none.

anchor: create placement or declaration; read S14, slabs, exports, landings, reader; regen kept by scoped regeneration, recomputed only by Re-derive from S7b; undo inverse setAttr; migrate a base world outline → anchor = its area centroid rounded to the lattice and the polygon less the anchor as rim.

rim, land: create SKY L0 batch; read unit run, draw, resize; persist arena geometry; regen re-derived by New random, kept by regenerate-keep; undo batch undo record; migrate base outline Polygon → rim chain by one insertChain in a fresh arena.
areaHa: supply law or edit; read resize, fill, reader; law re-evaluates only at an epoch; undo inverse.

altitudeCm, groundRefCm: create V5 §3.9 at SKY (caster ceiling incl. item 110), before field pass 2; SKY-F clearance; reclearIsland; setAttr; a move; V5 §4.3 ground edits; read elevationCm, slabs, marks, access runs; regen kept; a raise of groundRefCm keeps elevationCm and sets altitudeCm = elevationCm − new groundRefCm, raising elevationCm only where V5 §3.9 (4)'s floor fails (listed fate); New random re-checks the floor after re-drawing the underside; migrate base elevationCm → altitudeCm = elevationCm − groundRefCm.

underside: create SKY from rule row and island.place; read slab tiers, offset view, glTF, clearance; regen re-scaled by resize, re-drawn by New random unless source 'edit'; migrate base record gets the rule's default profile drawn on its slot's key; flat carries depthCm 0 and tiers 0.
terrain, river: create SKY (V5 §3.8); persist model digest (terrain raster in arena chunk); regen New random re-derives; T2 edits on island key; undo inverse.

terrainEcho (river, relief, reliefClass): create SKY (§3.8 (3)-(4)), own relief class drawn on island.place index relief; read island terrain, V01 terraceState and so levelling (V5 §3.22 (4)), context vector, exports; regen re-drawn by New random, kept by every other edit (T2 changes heights never class); migrate own island without reliefClass re-draws on island.place relief at load, written and reported (SLR3-03).
districts: create SKY-F from the unit run's NeighbourhoodResult.districts (V01 V1-2.4); rewritten by SKY-F after every unit run (generation, raise, New random, Re-derive); otherwise succession.

reason, institution: S7b (5) or an assignment; Re-derive from S7b. placement: V5 §3.7; kept by scoped regen. occlusion: absent; setAttr; kept. supply: every evaluation; recomputed at S7b and each epoch only; restored on undo.

field (mean, density, greenery) and gradient: create SKY (gradient from carried bands' shares, mean written), setAttr(field.prosperity) as declared target (declared.field), island brush strokes (setField with key); persist the three values; gradient raster never stored, rebuilt on load from terrain, rim, allocation, cuts and stroke list (as §2.9); regen recomputed at an epoch and a re-derivation from S7b, declared target and strokes held; migrate mean = older uniform value, no strokes.

shadeBasis: create every shade evaluation (SKY's last step at generation and any re-derivation that runs SKY; S10a's start before step (i) and every hook at a re-derivation starting after SKY and at or before S10a; each epoch's S6 for every non-fallen island; Update shade now) from the island as it stands; absent after an epoch's raiseIsland after S6, a T5 declaration or hand convert raiseIsland until the next; persist model digest ≤ 2.5 KB per island; regen rewritten only at evaluations, kept by every island edit, scoped regen and SKY-F (J-V5.27); undo restored by the undo record of the event whose evaluation rewrote it; migrate: a document predating §7.5's island-basis step computes once the basis of every island not fallen or removed from the stored island; at/after that version an absent basis is never computed at load (ST-49; J-V5.72).

accesses: V5 §3.10 or placeSkyAccess; kept by New random (tops re-seated). name: S13a; §6.3 naming cases. state, stateSince, dwellUntilWeek, landfall: IslandEpochStep or hand convert (removeIsland among them); never by a re-derivation; conversion's undo. declared: a declaring event; held.

removed (seq, generated, releasedBy): create convert removeIsland (T9 delete, clerk); releasedBy by a later T5 sky declaration re-filling the slot when no slot is free — never adjust('islands.count'), whose integer counts held slots as filled and opens only free slots (J-VI.14; file f item 260); read S7b (5) slot chain each re-derivation, V5 §3.15 (5) each epoch, report, clerk, removedSlots; regen held (J-V5.62); undo restores the island whole (arena from archive, households, accesses, landing uses), undoing the releasing event clears releasedBy; migrate absent = no removal.

removedAccesses: create fold of a delete whose target is a generated SkyAccess (ordinal appended); read V5 §3.10's siting at every re-derivation that re-sites accesses, the main succession, clerk; regen held (ordinal skipped and counted, lowest surviving generated ordinal takes main); undo removes the ordinal and restores the access; migrate absent = [].

Island RetainingWalls: create V01 unit run levelling (S10, S11), T3 retaining and T2 terrace with island key; persist island arena geometry; regen generated re-derive with terrain and plots (item 110 (a)), drawn held; undo batch/event record; migrate none before item 110.

SkyAccess.*: V5 §3.10 or placeSkyAccess; regen tops re-seated on a re-derived rim, and on a resized/reshaped one with feet re-landed as a move re-lands them (SLR3-02). Allocation row at, access: V5 §3.10; recomputed with the access.

Rim strip (setback line and rim_strip face) and island claims (each landing Reservation kind landing, institution claim): create SKY island L1 batch; read unit run via SkyHandover.rimStrip/.claims/.landings, S10b, V01 plantRimWalk, rim lights, SKY-F; persist arena geometry and reservations in the model digest; regen re-laid by one island L1 batch at a resize and rim reshape (strip rimStripM inside new rim, yards re-claimed at re-seated tops, institution claim kept or re-searched inside its district) and with SKY's island steps at New random and Re-derive from SKY or earlier; a yard claimed by placeSkyAccess and released by an access's delete; undo restores strip line, yards and claim.

Decoration.name, .source: fallIsland; never regenerated. Decoration.members (DecorationMember[]): create fallIsland (covered plots, land uses, reservations, ways, retaining walls by Id; covered raised spans and raised-way piers by raised way and item 244's support keys); read §8.2 fallen row (rubble over each member's face/band), V06 landfall candidate (V6 §3.5.2), V04 access closures (V4 §3.10), clerk, per-landfall CSV; regen never of its own, shrunk only by V06's member-leaving setAttr of members (J-V6.108) in the batch of whichever op ends a member's cover (landfall strike, repairRetaining, retypeLand, repairRaised, dismantle, any tombstoning op); decoration tombstoned with the last; migrate older Id list reads as it stands.

Way.formerClass (V06's field, V6 §2.8, BCR-V6-5; V05 a writer): fallIsland writes a covered way's class before dropping to track only where none; read V06 landfall clearance (restores and clears), upgradeWay, regrowth tier (5′), GeoJSON plat:formerClass; regen written again on replay; undo restores prior value; migrate a landfall before this rule has none: V6 §3.5.2 keeps track and reports landfallClassUnknown.

Enceinte.condition (file f item 575's step profile; V05 a writer): fallIsland writes breached over each covered wall stretch's covered length extended over each covered tower's and gate's footprint chord (any Gate kind), a wall_state_knot at each end; a run already dismantled kept (ladder only steps down); read §8.2 decayed row (gap glyph), lifecycle (decayed while any run not standing), §11.1 wall LineStrings split per run, V06 repair (V6 §3.7.5 repairWall), clerk; persist as item 245's profile; undo restores prior profile and lifecycle; migrate as item 575.

IslandShadeStrip onto the ground: create at S10a (generation and every re-derivation from S10a or earlier) once per shade evaluation at first read (V01 S9b at afterDrivers where registered, else field pass 2), held for pass 2's fold, and each epoch's S6, whatever w_sun; none without shadeBasis; persist held with field rasters, rebuilt on load/replay from shadeBasis and unlevelled ground heights, never from the live island, never in the log; regen kept by island edits and scoped regens (J-V5.27); undo restored with the field's former state; migrate pre-item-102 tables read w_sun = 0 (item 102 (g) no-op pin).

IslandShadeStrip onto an island and shadeSky: create SKY's last step after every island's own steps; a re-derivation starting after SKY at S10a's start after the bases; each epoch — from caster's and receiver's shadeBasis (none where either absent), at an epoch OR-ed with V06's building mask on the island lattice (V5 §3.19 (7)); read that island's context vector, V01's sky-arena readers; persist derived, rebuilt on load.

New table cells (institution archetypes/tags/handover/tower row, casterAllowanceM, shade, routing, node, carry, districtHa, fabricPrior, fabricRingHa, cryptFloorM, frameMarginM, field new cells, C5-33 constants incl. deckGapM, lineClearM): create table defaults; persist the table (§7.6); regen editTable re-derives from the first reader stage (S7b for node, carry, fill, institutionFit, districtHa; SKY for arena, access, crypt, shade cells; S7c for fabricPrior; S13a for naming; none for export); undo editTable's inverse; migrate older table version reads defaults.

Reservation.owner and .handedFrom of an S3 reservation an institution island leaves (BCR-V5-19): create S7b (5) when the slot's institution holds it — owner becomes the handover instance, or commons with kind re-typed park; read S10b, S12b (park), reader, clerk; regen re-made by re-derivation from S7b, kept by island edits; migrate absent handedFrom = no handover.

Island cathedral's crypt site: create SKY's claim site search (crypt-floor test); read the cathedral's basement crypt (V02/V03 Basement record persists it), fate list; not stored by V05; re-tested with every re-claim (resize, rim reshape, New random; a move leaves it standing).

EpochOps.demandTaken and displaced pool cause island: create IslandEpochStep; read V06 siting the same epoch; persist inside the epoch event only; regen recomputed by replay; undo the epoch event's undo.
Node term (derived, never stored): S7b (5) and each epoch's evaluation from the digest's site.deposits; recorded in the evaluation report only; a deposit change reaches it at the next epoch.

IslandShadeStrip.bits and mask layout: with the strip; a sampler digest that differs from the strip's basis recomputes it whole (as V06 §3.4 (5) for its mask); re-derived on load, never migrated. ContextVector.arena 'sky': the unit run's context read; derivation record; recomputed.
Stage S7b (5): gate, slots, reasons, fills, outline, placement per slot (V5 §3.2-§3.7); inside S7b before S7b (6) and (1); eager, town-wide; writes the sky Allocations, data only (no batch).

Stage SKY (SkyStrategy.place, per island in slot order): arena (§3.8), underside, ground reference, altitude (§3.9 (1)-(4)), access tops and feet, island claims, ground landing claims (§3.10), field (§3.11); then once every island has its solid its shade evaluation: every shadeBasis written, then strips onto islands and sky receivers' shade; runs after S7b (its S7c hook included, V01 §3.1) and before S12a, S8, S10a; S7c reads none of SKY's outputs; writes per island one L0 then one L1 batch, on the ground one L1 batch of landing claims (claimSubFace as S7b (3)).

S10a (base, item 102 (c)): the islands' strips onto the ground from each shadeBasis computed once per shade evaluation at first read (V01 S9b at afterDrivers between step (i) and pass 2 where registered, else field pass 2), held and OR-ed by pass 2 into the daylight per-sample mask; at a re-derivation starting after SKY and at or before S10a, first (at S10a's start before step (i) and every hook) the shadeBasis of every live island, then strips onto islands.

The unit run (V01 §3.10), one per island: after the ground's S10 (0) (V01 §3.10.3); concurrent with the pool on its own overlay, merged in lineage order like the hinterland unit (§4.1); writes only its island's arena.

SKY-F post step: clearance check (§3.9 (5)), landing check and repair (§3.12), sky lights (§3.13); after the pool's merge, before S12c and S13a; writes island records, LightSource records, at most one L1 repair batch per island.

Declared I/O (SL-01; J-V5.70): SKY's StageDecl (§4.12) reads S7b's outputs (with hooks united into host I/O, V01 §3.1, BCR-26, including S7c's) and writes on the ground only reservations.landing and allocations.landing; on each island its arena, records, field; no stage or hook before SKY declares either landing key (V01 S7c reads reservations as S3's and S7b (3)'s keys only); S8, S10a with hook S9b, and S12a declare both beside reservations and allocations, so §4.1's sort puts SKY after S7b (S7c included) and before S8, S10a, S12a with no cycle (T-V5-32); SKY rewrites no S7b row; S10a takes a landing's two staff households from the host district's modest demand reading both keys (BCR-V5-6).
The ground's L1 writers become S3, S4, S5, S6, S7, S7b, SKY and S8 in that order (BCR-V5-3).

Nothing of the sky runs on the one-click path: recipe.layers.islands off by default (D-3); with it off S7b (5) makes no allocation and SKY registers but does nothing; the ground model is byte-identical to the realism golden (T13-1).

Item 110's raised ways in the order (C5-47, C5-52; J-V5.63): relies on V01 BCR-39's recommended slot (BCR-V5-29 (a) repeats): every generated raised part committed before S7b (1) (viaduct inside S4, elevated road or aqueduct at S6's end), exists when S7b (5) places and SKY fixes groundRef, never reads an island (same raised-way set with islands on or off, T-V5-30); one existing when SKY runs is read by SKY (§3.7 (2), §3.9 (3), §3.10); one committed after SKY is read by SKY-F's clearance check, the epoch's re-check or the adding edit's dry run, and keeps clear of accesses via skyAccessObstacles.

Gate: islands exist only if recipe.layers.islands = 'on', RungProfile.layers.islands = 'possible' (CITY, METROPOLIS), the recipe is not a parity preset's (MFCG and FTG hold off; no reference has islands, item 23), and for a dossier-bound document DR-SKY's magic from site.magic is not none; a failed gate makes no allocation and reports islands: off, gated: rung or gated: dossier magic.

Forced slots: every declared island of the creation prefix (T5 quarter with sky) and every assignment with criteria sky: true forces the lowest free slot open in log order; a fourth is bent at its dry run to join the nearest open island as a district ('At most three islands float here; this quarter joins {island}'; J-VI.4 (a), item 101 R2).

Count: recipe.params['islands.count'] auto (default) or 0-3 (adjust). Integer n: exactly n slots open (forced first, a held slot counted as one; n below forced count raised to it at dry run, a bend J-VI.4 (a)), no draw. auto: each slot k above the forced ones opens with probability chance[k] · h_town and only if slot k−1 is open: one uniform on island.place keyed by the town's lineage, creation index slot:k.

Report lists count, forced slots and each slot's outcome (held: 'removed by you'); with the setting on, gate passed and no island, one plain sentence: 'Islands are on, but the city is not prosperous enough to keep one aloft' (h_town 0 or every slot no supply) or '… none rose this time' (empty draws), naming both remedies: raise wealth (T1 intend) or place by hand (T5 with sky, held against its supply, J-V5.10).

Removed slots (C5-51; J-V5.62): a slot held by a removed island record with releasedBy absent is closed with outcome 'removed by you' (no draw on slot:k or reason:k, no fill, outline, placement, SKY run); counts as open and filled for the slot chain (a higher slot draws on its own index as before) and toward an integer islands.count (never replaced by another slot's island); re-opened only by the removal's undo or a T5 sky declaration when no slot is free (J-VI.14; file f item 260: lowest held slot counts free; declaring event sets releasedBy).

A count never releases a hold (ST-04): an integer islands.count counts held slots as filled and opens only free slots (a cap increase opens only new keys, file f item 260); auto never draws a held slot; an adjust exceeding what it can open lists the fate 'slot k is held by your removal of <name>; undo the removal or draw an island to use it' and opens what it can; the removed island's households were relocated by its removal, so S7b (1) allocates them to the ground at every re-derivation and the population stays whole (T-V5-29).

S_town = mean prosperity P over built land: §4.5 32 m field cells whose centres lie in a district face (hinterland, underground, undercity, sky pseudo-districts excluded), less cells in water and in reservations of kind park, harbour_basin, moat or canal; at S7b the value after field pass 1, at an epoch after that epoch's re-evaluation (§4.11); read on the field's absolute value (J-V5.3; RV-pc-3).

S_carried = mean over carried households of their band's value v(b): midpoint of the band's two cuts on the absolute value (FieldBands.cuts), lowest band's lower cut 0 and top band's upper cut 1; an institution island's S_carried = v(requirementBand).

h_town and h_carried interpolate townSupply/carriedSupply linearly, 0 below the first row, 1 above the last; supported area A = areaHaMax · h_carried · h_town; law's altitude E = E_min + (E_max − E_min) · h_town (II.6 (5), unchanged in form).

Magical node (J-V5.41; BCR-V5-17): where site.deposits carries a magical_node available (or discovered, from the epoch after its discovery), h_town = min(1, interpolated + node.bonus); one addend however many deposits; depleted and removed add nothing; acts only where the interpolated value > 0; reaches every h_town reader (slots, A, E, epochs); no dossier = no node term; report and clerk why name the deposit when it acts; positionless (reads deposit state only, never the underground arena, item 2).

The clerk's why names 'the node beneath the old ruins' from the generation report's ruin.node line (V04 §3.5.0a (9): the deposit, the ruin system and the ruin's NameRef, so a renamed ruin reads its new name), never by reading the ruin; with no line it names the deposit alone (SLR1-02).

Calibration ⟨P0⟩: on 200 CITY and 100 METROPOLIS seeds at targets, wealthLevel ∈ {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1}, setting on, record S_town's median m_w per level; set townSupply (m_0.25, 0) (m_0.5, 0.5) (m_1, 1). Bars: median h_town at wealthLevel 0 ≤ 0.05, at 0.5 within [0.35, 0.65], at 1 ≥ 0.9 (standalone, no node term).

Pre-decided fallback: if m_1 − m_0 < 0.10, S_town becomes 0.5 · field mean + 0.5 · w (w = wealthLevel; with a dossier its DR6 value), rows re-fitted by the same rule, recorded as a declared shift. carriedSupply checked at the same run: h_carried(v(rich)) ≥ 0.7 and h_carried(v(modest)) = 0 at wealthLevel 0.5 on ≥ 90 % of seeds; else rows moved so the midpoint of v(modest) and v(comfortable) maps to 0 and v(rich) to 1, re-measured once.
Purpose per open slot in order: a forced slot takes its declaration's kind (institution kind → institution island, else prosperity) or its assignment's institution.

Candidates: prosperity (weight 1.0) where roster households of bands with h_carried(v(b)) > 0 not carried by an earlier slot give ≥ minAreaHa of plot land; each IslandInstitution row at its weight where the roster demands ≥ 1 eligible instance of a class carrying one of its tags (first tag in order, lowest roster ordinal) — or the dossier carries a custom institution whose resolved scene archetype is in the row's archetypes (landmarkOnly admits only landmarkLevel landmark; item 104 (a) (2)), lowest localUid first — that no earlier slot carries and no creation-prefix placeAt holds on the ground, requires.government holds, requires.magic admits the magic circumstance, and areaHaMax · h_carried(v(requirementBand)) · h_town ≥ fitFactor (1.3) × row areaHa.

An eligible instance is one building or one compound (item 108 (a)): a singular record, a record whose ladder step is SIZE, or a roster instance bound to neither — never a COUNT, GUILD or QUARTER record or a member #k of one; a dossier institution counts as a roster instance (DR9, DR24): the island moves where it stands, never whether it exists (§7.7).

The archetype is read at this draw only: a later revision of a custom kind re-resolves its profile and keeps it on its island unless a hard row of the new profile fails there, when item 104 (e)'s least disruption re-sites it on the ground; the island keeps its reason and claim; the vacated building steps down the building ladder; the regrowth-first order re-occupies it with the next instance of one of the row's tags or archetype before any ground site (§4.11; V5 §3.15 (4)).
The reason draw: one weighted choice on island.place (town lineage, index reason:k); with no candidate the slot closes, reported 'no supply' or 'nothing to carry'.

Prosperity slot fill (1)-(2): eligible bands those with h_carried(v(b)) > 0, richest first; households taken from the richest eligible band's residential demand in batches of fill.batchShare (1 %) of that band's demand (≥ 1 household), each batch split over classes by the band's class mix at its centre (item 71; largest remainder); S_carried and A recomputed after each batch.

Held shares never taken: households a dossier district-defining record's raised share holds on its ground district (item 72) — a QUARTER record of item 108 (a) among them — are subtracted from the band's demand before the fill; the island never drains a quarter the dossier names.

Fill stops at the first of: carried plot land (Σ plotArea(c,b) × count, S2's plot areas at band centres) reaching plotShare · A (plotShare = V01 hood.constants.sky.plotShare, default the base's dense-core share §4.2 S2; J-V5.45); carried households reaching fill.householdCapDistricts (3) × H_d (H_d = town households ÷ its district count after S6); or the band's demand exhausted, when the next band is taken only if the batch would leave the plot land within the recomputed plotShare · A; A falls as poorer households join, so it converges (II.6 (5)).

Carried workplaces via IslandRule.carry (J-V5.32, J-V5.39, J-V5.51): for each workplace or institution class demanded at the carried bands, the carried households' share of their band's households × its count by largest remainder, except (a)-(d).

(a) Never carried: IslandInstitution tags (their own slots); town-unique classes (§10.2's unique column: principal market, castle, government seat); balance profile in carry.never.balance (heavy processors mill, tannery, smelter, brewery, dyer; wholesale and storage); a class whose siting profile emits one of emitsTopStep at the top step; a hard NEEDS row naming a hardNeeds feature (conjured river and spring pond satisfy no NEEDS row, V5 §3.20 (1)); every resource or processing node of an active chain (custom, item 104 (b), or activeChains[] with processors resolved by kind family, item 105 (i); V08) — the island institution excepted; their demand stays on the ground (V5 §3.20 (9)).

(b) Carried by share: every class (a) does not exclude (carry.share.balance everyday services and town-wide specialists above all; a chain's final seller and its consumers). (c) Split across arenas: a class whose row declares split (item 105 (h)) and whose works (a) excludes: with carry.share.splitShop on, its shop may go up by share while its works stays on the ground (one item on two plots on two arenas; the shop building's Use.branchOf names the works' use; J-V5.51); item 105 (h)'s split threshold read with the route distance between the island's demand and the works' ground site; below it the class stays whole on the ground; every split reported; off in parity presets.

(d) Collective members (item 108 (b), (c)): a member #k of a COUNT, GUILD or QUARTER record carried by the share keeps its record and key; the record's range check (T73-4) counts its members on both arenas together; a lesser a greater subsumes is carried as that greater's member, never as an addition.

Coverage (item 103 (f); J-V5.37): the island counts as k units for a row counted by district or neighbourhood (k = V01 skyDistrictCount(plotLandM2, districtHa), computed here by the same call the unit runner makes), one unit for a walking-radius row (the route to the ground passes every walking radius), ⌈carried households ÷ N⌉ units for a per-N-households row; the island's units join S7b (1)'s coverage step beside the ground's districts (BCR-V5-16), which may add an instance from the demand it distributes — never remove one — unless it carries plot land past coverageOvershoot (1.05) × plotShare · A (unit skipped for that class, reported); inside the island S10b spreads a coverage class over districts and spaces same-kind members by item 107 (d).

If A < minAreaHa the slot closes (reported) and its rows return to the demand; the island's district count and partition are V01's (V01 §3.10.3 (2) with districtHa), V05 counts none (J-V5.28); one Allocation (level district, target the island's sky pseudo-district) holds the rows; S_carried and A written to the record-to-be.

Institution slot: the row's instance with claim set once SKY makes it (V5 §3.10), plus staffHouseholds households of the requirement band; A = min(law's A, institutionFit.areaCapShare (2.5) × row areaHa) — compact, surround the unit run's gardens, close or yard; claim's face typed by the row's districtKind.

A greater goes up alone (item 108 (c); J-V5.57): a greater subsuming lessers (cathedral over parish church, resident priest, wayside shrine) takes only its own building up; lessers stay separate buildings, members of its collective each keeping #k — on the ground by their own rules, on an island only by a prosperity slot's share; each counts once.

Ground reservation handover (J-V5.46; BCR-V5-19): where the instance holds an S3 reservation (temple/cathedral precinct §4.2 S3 (2), or a palace's by the castle's siting rules), the reservation stays exactly as is (no L1 change) and passes to the row's handover: the first tag the roster demands on the ground, its largest instance, which S10b places into it as its claim (owner = that instance, handedFrom = the institution that went up); a reservation sized for the greater keeps its size, surplus becoming the incoming instance's churchyard, close or garden by template yard rows (§4.9); with no such tag: park (re-typed park, owner commons, laid out by S12b as old palace gardens or old close's green) or none.

An institution the creation prefix sends up (T5 sky declaration of its kind, T6 criteria.sky assignment) leaves nothing to hand over: S3 never reserves it (BCR-V5-19); after generation (T6 assignment or an epoch's raiseIsland taking a ground institution up) its vacated building steps down the ladder and the regrowth-first order re-occupies it with the row's handover classes first; the report and clerk name the handover ('the old cathedral close — now the mother church').

Burial and crypt (item 109 (k) (2)-(3), J111; J-V5.43): an island church's churchyard part (§4.9's churchyard row) is a surface burial ground only — out of item 109 (k) (3)'s catacomb candidates and 'largest cemetery' ranking (V04's candidate list skips every sky-arena face); each island church counts once toward the catacomb count (V04 §3.5.1 (3), churchesPer); the island cathedral's crypt (always largest, V11 crypt column 'always') is a rim-slab vault under the cathedral, part of its building, never an UndergroundSystem part or item 109 (j) (3b) link, no catacomb beneath; the ground church taking the old close keeps its own crypt and is never ranked above the cathedral's.
The rest: S7b (1) allocates the remainder to the ground's districts, so the population stays whole (II.6).

Shape (1)-(2): template from a declaration's points form (lasso = outline itself; one point = disc of area A; two to four corners = routine fitted to their hull) else one weighted draw of outline.templates on island.place (index template); bearing = the ground's principal river's bearing (inlet to outfall) where the site has a river, else uniform on island.place (index bearing).

Shape (3)-(4): §4.2 S1 (2)'s closed-outline routine on the template's base curve with the rule's detail row and a uniform envelope (no town side), from island.place (index outline); scale set by one secant step so the displaced outline's area is A within 1 %; F-OUTLINE's ladder applies (§5.2); centroid = local origin; frame sized from the outline (V5 §3.8 (1)).

Placement class raster: 64 m raster over the ground frame; cells water (centre in an L0 water face), core (district of growth stage 1), outskirts (any other district), fields (outside the perimeter); built once per S7b from the ground plan then (L0, L1, districts, perimeter).

Placement candidates: centroids of a latticeM lattice whose translated outline lies inside the frame inset by frameInsetM, does not meet any placed island's projected outline dilated by gapM, and can be reached (J-V5.54): ≥ 1 rim cell on admissible ground (hoist/stair) or within the horizontal run of an admitted slanted access row (ropeway; lightBridge where magic admits) of admissible ground; admissible ground = land cells outside water, reservations, wall strips, every committed raised part's raised-way pier footprints, its deck's plan dilated by deckGapM (4 m) and every item 110 (d) deck face (a cell admissible when its centre is); tested by one chamfer distance transform (integer, 3-4 weights on 64 m cells) built once with the class raster (J-V5.60).

Placement score over the outline's cells: (a) mean class weight (prefs with institution overWeights; core at 1.0 when placed by assignment or declaration) × 1.0; (b) proximity − 0.5 × min(1, d ÷ nearM), d outline-to-perimeter (0 over the town); (c) purpose 0.5 × one term: palace/cathedral 1 − min(1, d ÷ row nearM) to the plaza (cathedral to the precinct where S3 reserved one), prison min(1, d ÷ row nearM) from the plaza, prosperity 1 − min(1, d ÷ nearM) to the district of highest prosperity mean (ties by address).

Placement draw: topK best (ties lattice y then x), one draw weighted by score − min score + 0.01 on island.place (index place); chosen centroid = anchor; placement.over = class of largest share under the outline (ties water, fields, outskirts, core); byAssignment set for a forced slot; F-SKY-PLACE when no candidate passes.

Frame: after the outline, a square centred on the local origin of side 2 × r_max × √1.5 + 2 × frameMarginM (40 m), rounded up to 10 m (r_max the outline's greatest distance from its centroid), so the outline grown to 1.5 × area by the buffer resize stays inside for any template; a declared or edited area past that grows the frame by §3.2 (9)'s single-level batches.

L0 batch: the arena's outer ring (margin role on the island Terrain), then the rim (the outline as one closed chain with the structural rim role, BCR-V5-2) making two faces: the void (L0 kind sky) between ring and rim, and the land (owner the island); every later batch lies inside the land face.

Island terrain: the ground's terrain cell; hydro grid at half the ground's hydro cell (12.5 m CITY, 16 m METROPOLIS); geology ordinary; heights a dome (domeM + domePerRadius · R) · (1 − (r/R)²) clamped at 0 (R = √(A/π)) plus for echo §4.2 S1 (1)'s fBm at the ground's relief class × amplitudeShare, for own the same at a class drawn by S0's relief weights on island.place (index relief) written to terrainEcho.reliefClass, for none nothing; noise on terrain.noise keyed by the island Terrain; surface tilts tiltPerMille along the river bearing toward its fall; void cells 0 and masked; datumCm = ground datum + elevationCm, rewritten whenever that changes.

Conjured river: where the ground has a river, A ≥ river.minAreaHa and a draw on island.place (index river) < river.chance: source on the long axis at sourceShare (0.15) from the upstream end (against the ground river's flow); traced and carved by §4.2 S1 (3)'s rivers by descent on the island hydro grid until it meets the rim; width w0 · (flowShare · acc)^0.4 (acc = ground river's accumulation nearest the anchor) clamped to [widthM[0], widthMinorShare × minor axis]; water face enters L0 with shore edges, bank kinds by §4.2 S1 (7); where it meets the rim the stretch carries both rim and shore and WaterBody.fall = true (BCR-V5-9).

The conjured river's crossing sites are §4.2 S1 (5)'s on the island, built by V01's unit run (V01 V1-3.10.3 (4)); a bridge may carry deck plots by item 110 (d) and they fall with the island (V5 §3.22 (6)); no raised part stands on an island (V5 §3.22 (3)); with no ground river a spring pond (pond, pondShare 0.015 × A at the terrain's highest basin, ties lattice y then x) by a draw below springPondChance; terrainEcho records the ground river, relief mode and own class; F-SKY-TERRAIN when the descent stalls.

Underside profile (SKY): kind drawn by rule weights on island.place (index underside.kind); rimThicknessCm the rule's; for non-flat depthCm = min(maxDepthM, depthPerRadius · R) · (0.8 + 0.4 · u) (u on index underside.depth), apexOffset a uniform point in the disc of radius apexOffsetShare · R (index underside.apex) pulled toward the centroid until the apex lies over the land face, tiers the rule's; flat: depthCm 0, apexOffset (0,0), tiers 0, no draw on depth/apex; roughness the rule's; source rule.

undersideTiers(island) (@plat/sky; pure view data computed by S14, never stored): for tier i = 1..n (n = tiers; none for flat) at z_i = i/n the ring is the rim eroded by R · (1 − ρ(z_i)) (kernel buffer on a transient arena, §3.4, §3.7, integer) translated by apexOffset · z_i, each vertex moved radially by roughness · R / n × a dmath noise keyed by the island's render key and tier; tier i spans elevation − rim − depth · z_(i−1) down to elevation − rim − depth · z_i; tier 0 = rim slab from the surface top down to elevation − rim; a tier whose ring falls below 1 % of the land's area ends the stack, the last tier then runs to the apex.

Ground reference (SKY, before any plot is cut): groundRefCm = greatest over the ground's 32 m field cells whose centres lie under the projected land face or any projected underside ring, of the terrain height at the cell centre plus the cell's caster ceiling = greatest of casterAllowanceM; the top of every caster already placed meeting the cell (wall band, tower, any gate, castle, bridge or pier deck — S5's and S7's, §8.4's casters — and every item 110 (b) raised part committed before SKY: deck top with parapet or aqueduct channel wall over the deck's plan, and its raised-way piers; any retaining wall and levelled platform committed before SKY at its high-side top); and the towerCm of every class with a tower (§4.7 S11) allocated to the district holding the cell (hinterland's allocation outside districts); reads only what exists at SKY so the altitude is final before S10a reads the shade (J-V5.29).

Altitude: altitudeCm = max(E, rim + depth + clearanceM) (so the apex clears the tallest thing beneath by clearanceM, J-V5.6) or the edited value bounded by the same floor (F-EDIT below it); elevationCm = groundRefCm + altitudeCm.

Surface top: the surfaceTopPercentile (95th) percentile over the land face of height at each point = levelledGroundCm on the island's key (platform datum where item 110 (a) levelled, else terrain) plus the eave of the building there — for a stepped building the eave of the highest massing tier over that point (wing baseCm + eaveCm, V02 §3.15.2); computed with the underside tiers (tier 0's top); the model's strip reads tier 0's top from the terrain alone at generation and from the full surface top at an epoch (item 102 (b): buildings cast only across epochs).

Clearance check (SKY-F after the pool's merge and unit runs): where a caster placed after SKY under the projected solid (building ridge or tower incl. a stepped building's top from V02's stack envelope, tree crown, raised part committed after SKY with parapet/channel wall and raised-way piers, retaining wall high-side top, or levelled ground raised by fill) stands above groundRefCm, groundRefCm is raised to its top keeping elevationCm (altitudeCm = elevationCm − new groundRefCm); only where (4)'s floor then fails is elevationCm raised (a listed fate); SKY-F never writes shadeBasis (strip keeps its pass-2 basis until next epoch or re-derivation), reported 'shade basis behind: clearance' (F-SKY-CLEAR).

Clearance measurement (P0): over 1 000 islands at CITY and METROPOLIS, share raised by SKY-F ≤ 1 %; fallback: casterAllowanceM becomes the measured 99.9th percentile of caster tops under islands rounded up to 5 m, re-measured once; with item 110 (C5-47): the measurement runs with item 110's terrace, raised-way and deck-plot rows on (defaults) and the fallback reads the same caster set; the clearance also holds after every epoch (V5 §3.15 (7)).

Access count: prosperity island min(accessCount.max, 1 + ⌊areaHa ÷ perHa⌋) (3; 5 ha), first main and the rest service; institution island its row's accesses; a removed ordinal holds (C5-51; J-V5.62): at every re-siting the ordinals in removedAccesses are skipped (no top, foot, claims) and counted toward the number (no replacement); the lowest surviving generated ordinal takes main (a guarded role kept by its own ordinal), the rest service.

Access directions: d_1 = bearing from the island's world centroid to the nearest ground district's centroid; d_k = d_1 + (k − 1) · 360° / n; each top = where the ray from the centroid at d_k last leaves the land face.

Access kind at each top among rows admitted by magic (guarded = hoist only): hoist or stair where the top's world point lies on ground land in an admissible face (district L1 face not a reservation, claim or wall strip, or a hinterland L1 face, less raised-way pier footprints, raised deck plans dilated by deckGapM, item 110 (d) deck faces; J-V5.60) and altitude within the row's limit; ropeway or lightBridge where an admissible land point lies within the row's horizontal run (nearest the main plaza for a rope line; highest ground for a light bridge; ties lattice y then x); one weighted draw among admitted kinds on island.place (index access:k).

A slanted access over a raised part (C5-48): a ropeway or lightBridge whose segment passes over a raised deck or raised-way pier keeps lineClearM (8 m) above its top (deck with parapet or channel wall, pier head) along the whole crossing; else the candidate foot is refused and F-SKY-ACCESS takes its next direction step.

Access foot: hoist/stair foot = the top's world point; ropeway/lightBridge foot = the chosen land point; feet keep footGapM (30 m) apart (a later foot moves to the nearest admissible point outside, ties lattice y then x); a foot and its yard on part-0 land only — never a deck face, raised-way pier or inside a raised deck's plan dilated by deckGapM; a yard that would meet one slides along the spine to the nearest clear position, else the foot moves as a gap violation does.
'The nearest way' (here and V5 §3.12) = a walkable part-0 way (C5-48 (4)): a raised part's deck counts only at the ground vertex of its ramp or stair foot, an aqueduct never.

Ground landing in a district: foot moved along the perpendicular to the nearest L1 way spine within wayReachM (or for a vertical access the yard stretched from the foot to the spine); SKY's ground L1 batch claims the yard (claimSubFace, yardWidthM × yardDepthM touching the spine) as a ground Reservation kind landing (reservations.landing) with its attach vertex on the spine; where no spine lies within wayReachM (at SKY only S3-S7's arterials, boundary ways, gate plazas exist) the yard is claimed at the foot, attach on the side facing the nearest way, registered as a destination S8 must reach (BCR-V5-20: S8's first cut runs from the attach to the nearest way by §4.6's lane rule), SKY-F checks a way meets it.

SKY writes under allocations.landing the positioned row {cls 'sky_landing', band 'modest', count 1, claim, at foot, access} for that district — beside the district's Allocation, never a rewrite; its two staff households are the row's, S10a takes them from the district's modest residential demand (BCR-V5-6); in the hinterland the same row for the hinterland's Allocation, sited by S12a at the foot with its trail to the nearest way by the hinterland unit (as a decoration's trail, §4.9); a secret access's ground landing is fronted (V5 §2.2).

The top: one splitThrough at L0 on the rim places the ('sky_access', id) vertex, pinned; SKY's island L1 batch lays the rim strip (closed L1 line rimStripM inside the rim, setback role, strip face typed block interior rim_strip, BCR-V5-6), claims each top's landing yard (yardWidthM × yardDepthM from the rim inward) as an island Reservation kind landing with attach on its inner side, and for an institution island the institution claim: one claimSubFace of the row's areaHa (§4.5 S7b (3)'s compact shape) on land less strip and yards, searched over a 10 m lattice (siteLatticeM) by score.

Institution claim scores: palace greatest mean terrain height under the claim among sites on the half of land facing d_1 (projection on d_1 ≥ 0; whole land if none fits); cathedral and tower least distance to the land face's centroid; prison least distance to centroid among sites whose claim dilated by prisonMarginM (20 m) still fits; ties by lattice y then x (J-V5.12's rule for every search here).

Crypt test (item 109 (k) (2), J111; J-V5.43, J-V5.66): the crypt lies under the building's lowest massing tier inside underside tier 0 (a stepped cathedral/great temple keeps it beneath massing tier 0); for a class with crypt always (cathedral, great temple), a site passes only if at every point of the claim terrain height less full basement depth (220 cm, V02's basement form) lies ≥ cryptFloorM (1 m) above the rim slab's base (elevationCm − rimThicknessCm); with the default 10 m rim this holds wherever terrain lies above −6.8 m; if no site passes the best site by score is taken and the crypt takes the half-sunk form (V02 basement ladder full → half → raised), listed as a fate ('the rock is too thin for a full crypt here'), F-SKY-CRYPT.

Crypt re-test: every later re-claim (resize, rim reshape, New random, terrain edit on the island) re-runs the test (form change a fate); after levelling (C5-50 (4)) SKY-F re-runs the test on the cathedral's plot at its levelled platform datum (levelledGroundCm) where S10/S11 levelled it — a platform cut into a slope lowers the floor.
Ground field at pass 2 (S10a) gains a positive kernel at each ground landing (landingKernel weight 0.05 within 150 m; BCR-V5-5).
F-SKY-ACCESS where a top has no admitted kind (V5 §3.17).
Institution island field is uniform: prosperity = v(requirementBand) of its row.

Prosperity island gradient (J-V5.18): on the island's 32 m lattice (cells in land less rim strip), P_I(x) = smooth(Q(r(x)) + ε(x)) − w_sun · shadeSky(x) + brush(x), clamped once to [0,1] and banded by the town's FieldBands cuts; each carried band gets a share of land equal to its share of carried plot land, richest on best ground.

Site rank r(x): elevation rank e (percentile of terrain height) and view rank v (percentile of view(x) = (1 − d_rim/R) · (1 + cos(θ(x) − θ_town))/2, θ_town the bearing from the land centroid's world point to the main plaza) combined as 0.6 · e + 0.4 · v and re-ranked, ties lattice y then x; on a none terrain every e ties and view decides.

Q maps rank to value by carried bands' shares: bands b_1 (richest)..b_m with shares s_j of carried plot land; ranks from 1 − Σ_{i≤j} s_i to 1 − Σ_{i<j} s_i map linearly onto [lo_j + ι, hi_j − ι] (lo/hi the band's absolute cuts, lowest 0, top 1; ι = bandInset (0.1) × (hi_j − lo_j)).

ε = the base's low-frequency fBm (§4.5) on field.chance keyed by the island, wavelength 120 m, share 0.05; smooth = the ground field's Gaussian of one block width (§4.5's O(N) three-box blur) over the lattice.

shadeSky(x) = share of the nine model sun samples in which a higher island's solid blocks the sun at x (OR sample by sample of the strips onto this island) and, after an epoch, the island's own buildings (V06's building shade mask run on the island lattice, V5 §3.19 (7)); the island's relief casts nothing on itself (J-V5.33).

brush(x) = the island's prosperity brush strokes (setField with key) as §7.2's stroke overrides; a declared target mean (setAttr(field.prosperity), declared.field) adds one uniform shift so the lattice mean of smooth(Q + ε) equals it.

With ε, shade and brush at 0 each carried band holds exactly its carried share of lattice cells (within smoothing boundary cells), so §4.7 S10a's band capacity houses every carried band on its own ground and re-homes none (T-V5-9); SkyIsland.field records prosperity = lattice mean of P_I, density = mean ground density field over cells whose band is carried, greenery = same mean of greenery + greeneryBonus; SkyHandover.field carries the raster before the brush (the unit run applies strokes); raster never stored, rebuilt on load (§2.9).

Sky-arena context vector (BCR-V5-6): prosperity = P_I bilinear; density, greenery as field; dist.centre to land centroid; dist.plaza and dist.market to the institution claim on an institution island else the route distance to the ground's plaza and nearest market; dist.gate to the nearest landing attach; dist.wall to an author's island wall else none; dist.water to the conjured river or pond; dist.shore to the rim; slope, aspect, upstream, terrainClass from island terrain (high, damp within 10 m of island water); upwind from the ground's wind; growthStage 1; arena 'sky'; V01's field step on the island reads these through skyHandover, replacing a character offset from h(S_carried).

The fabric hint is a prior, never a strategy (J-V5.48): on every island district S7c multiplies the hinted template's weight by fabricPrior (3); a prosperity island's hint is ring from fabricRingHa (6 ha), bent-cut below; an institution island's is its row's (street palace, landmark cathedral, square prison/tower); always a valid FabricStrategyId (V01 §2.1).

The unit run must: write only the island's arena; never cut or plot the rim strip, planting it as a rim walk once after its districts' S12b by V01's plantRimWalk (one esplanade Greenery on the strip face, no way; a street_trees Greenery along the inner setback line, its along naming the strip with no way, V01 BCR-10 (c), spaced by §4.9's street-tree row; J-V5.26); reach every landing attach with a way; cut the institution claim as a hole and place the institution by S10b; use the river's crossing sites as V01 qualifies and builds them (both deck ends on the unit's outline face get a span and street; far bank unreached stays a site reported in requestedVsBuilt; non-qualifying stays site unlaid); split the allocation over districts; read the field from the handover; measure every pull to another arena by the route distance; level island ground by item 110 (a) thresholds, never a retaining wall on the rim strip or along the rim; leave SeamReport.portalsTotal 0; return district ids for SKY-F.

SKY-F checks: every landing yard holds a sky_landing_top plot; a way meets every island attach; a walkable part-0 way meets every ground landing attach after S8; no island RetainingWall on the rim strip or along the rim; re-runs the crypt test at the levelled datum; a missing island way repaired by one island L1 batch laying the shortest lane from the attach to the fabric (S8's lane width); a missing ground way by one ground L1 batch in the landing's district (its lane rule); an unreachable landing reported by F-SKY-ACCESS's last rung.

Reconciliation with V01 §3.10.3 (read 2026-09-28): seven unit-run inputs are V05's and govern where the volumes differ, each naming the V01 line it replaces, all listed for V01's revision (V5 §13): (1) the call = the sky request + skyHandover (one caller); (2) terrain: no S1 in the runner (SKY committed L0, terrain, river); (3) field: the runner reads SkyHandover.field and applies brush strokes (not characterOffset from h(S_carried)); (4) claims, landings, rim strip: outline = land less strip, yards, claim; each attach a gate-ranked destination; rim strip replaces step 4's S10 (0) margin band; (5) district kinds = context.districtKind (sky-island or the row's sky-* on the claim's face); (6) fabric prior (no strategy); (7) district count = V01 skyDistrictCount with context.districtHa and plotShare (a full CITY island 2-3 districts, METROPOLIS 3).

Sky light rows (own, extension; BCR-V5-8): rim — magical orbs along the rim strip's outer edge every 40 m, 2.5 m high, 60 cd × h_carried, radius 18 m, orb 30 cm, cool, steady; keel — one downward source at the root's apex (flat: rim slab base under the land centroid), 4 000 cd × h_carried, radius = apex clearance + radiusMarginM (30 m), size 3 m, cool, steady; skyAccess — a lantern at each top, 25 cd, 3 m, radius 12 m, fire, flicker.

Island ordinary fabric takes the ground light rows (arena ground); each ground landing's lantern is its sky_landing class's door row; magic gates no sky row (J-V5.9); a waning island's magical lights scale with its h_carried at each epoch; a settled island's are 0.

Names: S13a draws each island's name on its naming stream (§6.3), reading reason and institution kind, the echoed river's name, the nearest ground district below (ties by address), the altitude class (low < 90 m, high ≥ 150 m), the town's culture row (§10.4); grammar rows V11's (slice naming.island); each island roots its own QuarterNode (members its districts, cityCut true) named with the island's name so its quarter label draws at the city band; an institution's own name is its landmark label; a landfall's place label takes the grammar's fallen form of the island's name.

IslandEpochStep.apply(doc, epoch) → ConversionOp[] (@plat/sky), called by V06 each epoch after S6's field re-evaluation and before S7b's delta allocation; registered in §4.12's StrategyRegistry as V06's EpochParticipant id sky.islands, step afterField, order 0, stage SKY (V06 §2.1, §3.2 row 5); run(ctx) calls apply(ctx.doc, ctx.epoch) with years = ctx.years, rung = ctx.rung; draws on island.place (never ctx.stream); returns EpochOps.ops in island slot order.
Second participant sky.clearance at step afterGrowth, order 50 (after V06's hood.fabric order 40), stage SKY; runs step 7 (BCR-V5-28, listed for V06).

Households move through V06's typed channels (BCR-V5-23): every household the step releases (wane leavers, settle remainder, a fall's covered homes in an epoch) enters V06's displaced pool with cause island (V06 §3.8.1: placed first at the siting step, V06 §3.2 row 13, addresses kept, each a relocate); every household a refloat or raise takes up from the delta demand is reserved by EpochOps.demandTaken {band, count}[] which siting subtracts before housing the rest; existing households relocated up are relocate ops; ground + sky households equal the epoch target after siting (T-V5-21 (g)); years = the epoch span (§4.11 (5)); rates per year.

Step 1 Evaluate: the rung row of the epoch's rung — the fold's ctx.rung (V6 §3.1 (3); §4.11 as file f item 322 amends), inside the hand-off band the previous product's own rung (TR-22); none makes the target area 0; else S_town from the re-evaluated field's island-free value (item 102 (c); BCR-V5-15), node term from deposits at the epoch, S_carried from the island's households' bands under new cuts (institution: requirement band), targets A_t and E_t by V5 §3.3; supply rewritten.
